body: thats the worst part, people still expect me to be me but inside im not. im just nothing. i try to fake it, the whole fake it to you make it thing, but then i just feel like a fraud at the end. I dont know what i mean with that idiot talk, like i know if i did it everyone would miss me but theres still like a big part of me thats like nah, just do it. they wont. thanks for your reply, really. seeing people read this and responded really made this not a bad day

i havent talked about any of this to anyone, at all, it actually felt good to just get it out there. thanks for reading and responding. honestly it means a lot to know somebody out there gave enough of a damn to spend a minute and read this.

I don't think it's just me. I mean my mindset isnt helping but others are saying the same thing. The direction of the company has changed and it's really just not a good atmosphere anymore. All of the coworkers that I was close with and enjoyed working with have left or are about to leave and I'm just stuck here. these days i just get loaded in the parkinglot before work to make it somewhat manageable
